Data frame of CIS-BP's TF family classification scheme

Source: R/data.R
cisbp_scheme.Rd

DNA-binding domains (DBDs) used by CIS-BP to identify TFs, and the TF family corresponding to each DBD. Genes with more than one type of DBD are assigned to a family whose name is the family names of all DBDs sorted alphabetically (case-insensitive) and separated by ',' (e.g., 'Homeodomain,POU'), as in CIS-BP. DBDs and families were obtained from CIS-BP (build 3.10), and DBDs were matched to Pfam (release 38.2) accessions. Some Pfam families were renamed since they were used by CIS-BP (e.g., 'DUF260' is now 'LOB'), and the Pfam family 'FLO_LFY' was split into 'SAM_LFY' (PF01698) and 'C_LFY_FLO' (PF17538), both of which are used for family 'Leafy'. The RNA-binding domains 'RRM_1' and 'zf-CCCH' are not included, as CIS-BP classifies TFs in families 'RRM' and 'CCCH ZF' only if there is experimental evidence of DNA binding (6 TFs in CIS-BP 3.10), and never uses these domains for TFs with other DBDs.

Usage

data(cisbp_scheme)

Format

A data frame with the following variables:

Family

CIS-BP family of TFs with the DBD.

CISBP_DBD

DBD name in CIS-BP.

Pfam

Pfam accession of the DBD.

Pfam_name

Pfam name of the DBD (Pfam 38.2).

Pfam_description

Pfam description of the DBD.

References

Weirauch, M. T., Yang, A., Albu, M., Cote, A. G., Montenegro-Montero, A., Drewe, P., ... & Hughes, T. R. (2014). Determination and inference of eukaryotic transcription factor sequence specificity. Cell, 158(6), 1431-1443.

Examples

data(cisbp_scheme)
